title: Utility Payment Record Bonus on the Courtesy Waiver Share
content:
A household on an Apartment Home Lease whose utility account received twelve or more utility payments with bill dates in the last 12 months (after the same day of the month twelve months before the handling date) and shows no utility balance due adds 0.05 to the courtesy waiver share; a household with twelve or more such payments and a utility balance due adds 0.02; any other household adds nothing.

**Records read.** The customer's Utility Services Program account: its utility payment entries, counted by bill date within the last 12 months, and the balance due on the active utility account.

**Effect on the share.** The bonus is added to the waiver share before the share is applied to the covered late fees, and the waiver share never exceeds the whole.

## Resident terms at a glance

| Utility payments with bill dates in the last 12 months | Utility balance due | Bonus added to the waiver share |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | none (0.00) | 0.05 |
| 12 or more | above 0.00 | 0.02 |
| 11 or fewer | any | nothing |

**Boundaries.** Eleven utility payments in the window add nothing whatever the balance; the twelfth brings the household into one of the first two rows.

**Window (hypothetical).** Handling date 8 September 2026: a utility payment with a bill date of 9 September 2025 is inside the last 12 months; one with a bill date of 8 September 2025 is not.

*Hypothetical effect:* a waiver share of 0.80 with 13 utility payments in the window and no utility balance due becomes 0.85; with a utility balance of $42.10 due it becomes 0.82.
